name: Weekly social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, X)
description: The Community Manager picks this week's topics, the Content Maker writes a post per platform with an on-brand image, then publishes them through Postiz. Every post waits for your approval before anything goes out.

params.label: Company and what to talk about this week
After approval: draft, now, or schedule

steps.task: Plan {{count}} social media topics for {{week}} for: {{prompt}}. Use the content-calendar skill. Platforms: Instagram, LinkedIn and X. Use only real facts from the brief, the workspace and cited sources. Write social/plan.md.
steps.successCriteria: social/plan.md with {{count}} topics, pillars, platforms, hooks, visual ideas and sources

steps.task: For every topic in social/plan.md write posts in {{language}} for Instagram, LinkedIn and X (posts.md per topic folder, each text within the platform limit) and make the images with the brand-card skill: Instagram 1080x1350 and LinkedIn/X 1200x627 SVG cards rendered to PNG with mcp__media__render_png. Do not publish in this step.
steps.successCriteria: a folder per topic with posts.md and PNG cards; no {{ placeholders and no [FACT NEEDED] left

steps.task: Publish the posts from the topic folders under social/ through Postiz: call mcp__social__list_channels, then one mcp__social__create_post per topic with an entry for each connected Instagram, LinkedIn and X account (its own text and PNG). Use when="{{publish}}" ("draft", "now", or a date-time; for a schedule spread the topics over {{week}} at 09:30 Baku time). Skip any post that still has [FACT NEEDED]. If social is not set up, write social/to-post.md with the texts and image paths for posting by hand.
steps.successCriteria: every post approved and sent to Postiz (or listed in social/to-post.md), with a short report of what went where
